description: Signal component that transforms raw market ticks and bars into normalized feature vectors (V1: 11 base+phase1, V2: +3 additive, futures: +3, pillars: +4, price_motion: +12 fields) for downstream decision making, regime detection, and risk assessment. Also hosts bar-based strategy infrastructure (MR, MD-AMR).

exports.notes: tick-only feature contract; bar consumers must not subscribe

ssot_notes.feature_catalog: contracts.py V1_FEATURE_METADATA / V2_FEATURE_METADATA is the canonical feature list with range, neutral, monotonicity
ssot_notes.computation_engine: calculation_engine.py is the sole runtime feature computer. indicators.py provides pure-math helpers
ssot_notes.config: FeatureEngineeringConfig wraps AuroraConfig (Pydantic, extra='forbid'). 60+ typed properties from config/aurora/domains.yaml
ssot_notes.normalization: V1 base: native ranges; V1 phase1: [0,1]; V2 volume_zscore: tanh([0,1]); spread_bps: unbounded R+
ssot_notes.strategy_infra: MR + MD-AMR strategy classes live in FE but are semantically owned by DM. DM production code uses decision_making/strategy_bridge.py facade. Direct DM imports from FE strategy files are forbidden (FE-DM-BOUNDARY-STABILIZATION 2026-03-15).
ssot_notes.duplicate_sma_atr: regime_detector has independent SMA/ATR (Decimal, rolling buffers). Intentional — different precision/lifecycle
ssot_notes.registry_verbs: FEATURES_CALCULATED (bar-only, active, owner), TICK_FEATURES_CALCULATED (tick-only, active, owner), FUNDING_UPDATE (experimental, owner), PROCESS_STRATEGY_BLOCKED (active, owner). CMD:PROCESS_STRATEGY (owner: strategies, schema in FE)
